agent_explanation: Single body in free fall with no walls and controller disabled gains ~223 J in 0.08 s. Per-step dv is 1.6176 m/s, exactly 6x g*dt (0.2696 m/s), while inspect shows ~50-53 substeps_in_step. The substep loop therefore over-applies gravity/velocity update relative to time advanced, injecting kinetic energy each substep without the matching potential drop, breaking energy conservation. Small-dt run with substeps=1 conserves energy, confirming the substep integration as cause.
